_comment: Crash-dump policy for the Windows test VM. golden-image-pre-reboot.ps1 applies the golden-image settings and golden-image-post-reboot.ps1 verifies them. At runtime, validate-crash-settings.ps1 compares live registry values and types against recommended.values and checks that recommended.absentValues are absent. It reports drift without changing the registry. Keep recommended.values.CrashDumpEnabled in sync with the entry selected by recommended.crashDumpType.

none.description: Do not write a Windows crash dump.

complete.description: Complete Memory Dump: records physical memory used by Windows. Microsoft lists RAM plus 257 MB as the page-file minimum for a complete dump on 64-bit Windows. This workflow does not use a dedicated dump file.

kernel.description: Kernel Memory Dump: captures kernel and driver memory, not memory allocated to user-mode programs.

automatic.description: Automatic Memory Dump: contains the same information as a Kernel Memory Dump. Windows can adjust page-file sizing for this mode when the page file is system-managed. This test image uses a fixed page file instead.

filtered.description: Active Memory Dump: includes relevant kernel and user-mode pages and filters out less useful pages. On a Windows host running nested VMs, it excludes child VM memory. This Windows dump mode does not control the separate KubeVirt memory capture.

recommended.notes: AutoReboot=0 prevents Windows from restarting itself after the simulated crash so the VM remains available for capture. src/scripts/host/watch-crash.sh starts the VM again afterward unless --no-restart is set. Windows uses the page file for crash-dump staging; small dumps are outside this workflow. Separately, KubeVirt captures guest memory as vm-memory.elf.tar.gz and the VM disk is extracted offline. Treat memory dumps and extracted disks as sensitive artifacts. Restrict access and retain them only as long as needed for diagnosis.

pageFile.notes: golden-image-pre-reboot.ps1 configures a fixed C:\pagefile.sys with both size fields set to guest physical RAM plus 257 MB. For this workflow, PagingFiles must contain a C: entry in the form <path> <initialMB> <maxMB>, with both sizes at least guest physical RAM plus 257 MB. Missing and system-managed page files do not meet this project policy. This threshold is not a general requirement for Automatic Memory Dump.
